rightarm3 = 2c2c2c | shorts3 = 2c2c2c | socks3 = 2c2c2c }} '''Galatasaray Spor Kulübü''' (''Galatasaray Sports Club''), usually referred to as '''Galatasaray''' (recognized as '''Galatasaray A.Ş.''' by [[Turkish Football Federation|TFF]] and [[UEFA]]), is a Turkish professional football club based in [[Istanbul]]. It is the association football branch of the larger [[Galatasaray Sports Club]] of the same name, itself a part of the [[Galatasaray Community|Galatasaray Community Cooperation Committee]] which includes [[Galatasaray High School]], where the football club was founded in 1905, consisting entirely of students. The team plays in dark shades of red and yellow at home, with the shirts split down the middle between the two colours. Galatasaray is one of three teams to have [[List of unrelegated association football clubs|participated in all seasons]] of the [[Süper Lig]] since 1959, following the dissolution of the [[Istanbul Football League]]. Galatasaray has the most [[Süper Lig]] (26), [[Turkish Cup]] (19) and [[Turkish Super Cup]] (17) titles in Turkey.{{Cite web |title=Süper Lig Tarihçe Şampiyonluklar Arşiv Gol Krallığı TFF |url=https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=545 |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=Tff.org |archive-date=25 July 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190725114314/http://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=545 |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |title=Türkiye Kupası Tarihçe ve Arşiv TFF |url=https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=411 |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=Tff.org }}{{Cite web |title=Turkcell Süper Kupa Tarihçesi TFF |url=https://www.tff.org/default.aspx?pageID=412 |access-date=2022-05-07 |website=Tff.org }} Galatasaray is the most successful Turkish club in European competitions. Galatasaray won the [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]] and [[UEFA Super Cup]] in [[2000 UEFA Super Cup|2000]], becoming the only Turkish team to win a major [[UEFA competitions|UEFA competition]]. In the [[1999–2000 Galatasaray S.K. season|1999–2000]] season, the club achieved the rare feat of completing a treble by winning the Süper Lig, Turkish Cup, and UEFA Cup in a single season. In the [[UEFA Champions League]], Galatasaray has reached the quarter-finals several times and the semi-finals of [[UEFA Cup Winners' Cup|Club Champions Cup]] once. Galatasaray is the only Turkish club to have been ranked first on the [[IFFHS]] World Rankings.{{cite web |url=http://arsiv.ntvmsnbc.com/news/54333.asp |title=Galatasaray, Ağustos ayının en iyisi |website=arsiv.ntvmsnbc.com |access-date=30 September 2013 |archive-date=2 October 2013 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20131002174733/http://arsiv.ntvmsnbc.com/news/54333.asp |url-status=live}} According to IFFHS, Galatasaray is the most successful Turkish club of the 20th century, and the 20th most successful club in Europe.{{Cite web |url=https://kouvadiarides.wordpress.com/2009/09/10/ |title=10 Σεπτεμβρίου, 2009 |access-date=11 July 2021 |archive-date=11 July 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210711100144/https://kouvadiarides.wordpress.com/2009/09/10/ |url-status=live}}{{Cite web |title=All-time Clubs - Most appearances Stats: UEFA Champions League |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/history/rankings/teams/appearances/ |access-date=2024-10-16 |website=[[UEFA]] |language=en}}{{Cite web |title=All-time Clubs - Matches played Stats: UEFA Champions League |url=https://www.uefa.com/uefachampionsleague/history/rankings/teams/matches_played/ |access-date=2024-10-16 |website=[[UEFA]] |language=en}} As of 2026, they are 2nd in the [[UEFA coefficient]] rankings among Turkish teams.{{Cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/uefarankings/news/0252-0cda38714c0d-0874ab234eb6-1000--how-men-s-club-coefficients-are-calculated/|title=Club coefficients | UEFA rankings|date=30 June 2024|website=UEFA.com|access-date=7 June 2026}} Since 2011, the club's stadium has been the 53,387-capacity [[Rams Park]] in the Seyrantepe district of Istanbul. Previously, the club played at the [[Ali Sami Yen Stadium]], as well as a succession of other stadium in Istanbul, which included stadium shares with [[Beşiktaş J.K.|Beşiktaş]] and [[Fenerbahçe S.K. (football)|Fenerbahçe]] at the [[Taksim Stadium]] and [[BJK İnönü Stadium|İnönü Stadium]]. The club has a long-standing rivalry with other Istanbul teams, namely Beşiktaş and Fenerbahçe. The derby between Galatasaray and Fenerbahçe is dubbed the ''[[Kıtalar Arası Derbi]]'' ({{langx|en|link=no|Intercontinental Derby}}) due to the location of their stadiums on the European (Galatasaray) and Asian (Fenerbahçe) sides of the [[Bosphorus]] [[strait]]."}}
